sections.section: Assessing Generative Models via Precision and Recall (p. 1–15)

omissions.source: For simplicity, we consider distributions P and Q that are defined on a finite state space, though the notion of precision and recall can be extended to arbitrary distributions.
Unfortunately, it is not possible to compute this quantity for more complex data sets.

distortions.source: To our knowledge, this is the first metric which confirms the folklore that VAEs are biased towards higher recall, but may suffer from precision issues (e.g., due to blurring effects), at least on this data set.
distortions.summary: This provides the first empirical metric confirmation of the folklore that VAEs are biased toward higher recall but may suffer precision issues (e.g., blurring), while GANs tend toward higher precision at the risk of mode collapse.
